refinement_prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is target. Image2 is physical hand-painted swatch reference only. Strictly REPLACE the colored fills listed below, including ALL panel fills and color chips, with these hues. Previous edit is still too vivid or wrong hue. Approximate digital anchors clarify desired relative hue; they are not measurements:
35: muted yellow-green yellow #C3C21B, not pure lemon
75: PALE DUSTY LAVENDER #B7A0C1, low saturation, reddish lavender; NEVER blue/indigo/periwinkle
Keep every other fill, all geometry, composition, all numeric codes, typography and step sequence. If instructional sheet, replace misleading Chinese color adjectives:35=偏黄绿的黄，37=黄绿，75=浅薰衣草紫，82=深紫，25=浅灰米，58=灰调青绿，65=蓝绿，143=极浅青灰，172=极浅灰绿. Remove 柠檬黄/薄荷小鸟/珊瑚粉/深蓝 when those refer to these codes. In every panel: early pencil remains uncolored; final only black contours. Preserve paperwhite shapes. No gradient, no added objects, no layout changes. Umbrella if present: keep straight rod+straight grip on canopy's vertical center axis.
